gitlens.ai.generateCommitMessage.customI: Return exactly ONE line: type: short summary. Choose ONE type for the main change: feat (new functionality), fix (bug correction), refactor (restructuring), docs (documentation only), test (tests only), or chore (maintenance). Summarize mixed changes together. No body, bullets, additional messages, or explanations. Use type! for breaking changes. Example: feat: add persistent demo execution and reconciliation
